svg.font-family: Segoe UI, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Arif Visual Answers: architecture and data flow
Three request paths (upload, ask, approve). Ask splits into the visual-answer path and the agent path.
skipped if all pages have text
② ASK POST /api/ask → text/event-stream (AG-UI event names)
SSE: TEXT_MESSAGE_* · COMPONENT_PLANNED · COMPONENT · COMPONENT_DROPPED · WARNING · METRICS · RUN_FINISHED
AGENT PATH (Groq tool calling · never cached)
SSE: RUN_STARTED{agent} · TOOL_CALL_START / RESULT · TEXT_MESSAGE_* · COMPONENT (cards) · METRICS{tools}
③ APPROVE the only path that creates a task or saves a draft
edits: title · owner · due · to · body
approved tasks and drafts → Tasks tab (owner, due date, source sentence)
hidden text never used as evidence
